entries.back_en: "Really!? Thank you so much! That means I can get back to where my friend is waiting for me!"
entries.note: Minor: 'me esperando' adds 'for me', sense preserved.

entries.back_en: "You all should go to Chamba -- you can reach the desert from there! But if you don't hurry, those troops will get there first!"
entries.note: 'Voces' plural vs singular 'you', acceptable; meaning intact.
